rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the measured land unit.

example.english: This plot of farmland is an acre in size.
example.traditional: 呢塊農地有一英畝咁大。
example.jyutping: nei1 faai3 nung4 dei6 jau5 jat1 jing1 mau5 gam3 daai6

rows.note: Use this for a broad physical area or expanse, rather than for a measured unit or a general quantity.

example.english: Below the hill is a whole acre of open ground, perfect for camping.
example.traditional: 山頂下面有一大片地方，啱晒畀人紮營。
example.jyutping: saan1 deng2 haa6 min6 jau5 jat1 daai6 pin2 dei6 fong1 ngaam1 saai3 bei2 jan4 zaat3 jing4

rows.note: Use this colloquial quantity expression for plenty of things, time, or money, not for a measured area.

example.english: I still have loads of time—an acre of it, really—so there’s no need to rush.
example.traditional: 我仲有大把時間，唔使咁心急。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 daai6 baa2 si4 gaan1 m4 sai2 gam3 sam1 gap1
